grounding_note: Grid re-read from the classified preview raster (data/source/panjim_crz_classified_map.png), assumed to span exactly the pilot bbox in plain lon/lat; ~0.0005 deg cells, a class is assigned where it covers >= 30% of a cell. Thin CRZ bands (NDZ, CRZ-II strips) are under-represented at this cell size; see areaCheck. 92 inland cells matching the CRZ-IVA colour but not connected to the open sea were reset to unclassified. Khazan mask inherits the case study's placeholder_needs_calibration status.
